membership_rationale: Secondaries-led evergreen PE tender-offer fund - wrapper and strategy twin of hl_paf/stepstone_spm.
what: typed projections of evidenced cells, zero new facts. Every field carries its source_cell and mirrors its status

mgmt_fee_base.note: leverage-inclusive: total assets incl. borrowings minus non-borrowing liabilities

value.structure: 12.5% of quarterly net profits above the Loss Recovery Account balance (no fixed hurdle, the LRA carries losses forward)

repurchase_cap_pct.note: intended cap: 'quarterly repurchase offers of no more than 5% of the Fund's NET ASSETS', board-discretionary (Rule 13e-4 tenders)

gate_history.reason: tendered-versus-accepted amounts and proration incidence per offer are not printed (final tender amendments not on disk). Four offers in each of FY2025 and FY2026 establish continuity, not full fills (R2-P1-12 rule)

expense_ratio_pct.note: FY2026 Class I gross (net 4.99% after 0.03% waiver). Includes 1.60% incentive-fee drag. AFFE excluded
expense_ratio_pct.basis: gross, before a 0.03% waiver, including the 1.60% incentive-fee drag, AFFE excluded (FY2026, Class I)

net_assets_usd.reason: aggregate net assets not yet carried into a typed cell. Verification-queue item

repurchase_program_status.reason: no suspension language in 3.1 or 3.3 as of 2026-03-31

dealing_cadence.note: cell 3.1: 'quarterly repurchase offers of no more than 5% of the Fund's NET ASSETS'

cap_period.note: cell 3.1: 'quarterly repurchase offers of no more than 5% of the Fund's NET ASSETS'
cap_period.evidence_phrase: quarterly repurchase offers of no more than 5%

repurchase_caps.note: cell 3.1: 'quarterly repurchase offers of no more than 5% of the Fund's NET ASSETS'

liquidity_verdict_by_plan.note: ILLUSTRATIVE scenario verdict per plan (demand model at the default sliders against the typed capacity)

slot_k_by_descriptor.note: the meaningful benchmark is a cited index whose series is not held (decision 8.5)

pme_public_proxy.note: KS-PME vs PSP over 2022-04-01 to 2026-03-31 (reference comparison, not the meaningful benchmark), fund return source: filed fiscal-year returns

direct_alpha_public_proxy.note: KS-PME vs PSP over 2022-04-01 to 2026-03-31 (reference comparison, not the meaningful benchmark), fund return source: filed fiscal-year returns

slot_k_relative_wealth_ratio.reason: the meaningful benchmark is not a held appraisal-based series

peer_relative_wealth_ratio.note: relative wealth ratio vs the peer composite over FY2023 to FY2026 (years to 03-31) (n=3), fund return source: filed fiscal-year returns. Not a public market equivalent
